Attack when the blade glows to expel powerful flames.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 24 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Flamespear}} Flamespears are [[Weapon]]s that can be found in the [[Hebra Mountains]]. They are also found within [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] in [[Hyrule Field]]. They were forged in the magma of [[Death Mountain]]. They belong to the [[Magic Gear]] equipment archetype, which is a series of Weapons with elemental properties.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC|publisher= |page= 174}} Their attacks deal [[Fire]] damage when they are used while they glow. Equipping a Flamespear in a [[Freezing Climate]] will grant [[Link]] one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. Finally, they will one-shot any [[Ice]]-type [[Enemy|Enemies]] they are used against.{{Cite|{{Big|Elemental Weaknesses}}
If you use a fiery attack against an icy enemy, you may defeat it in one hit.|Tips and Tricks|BotW}} Being made of metal, Flamespears will attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink when they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
